description: Hyalmass is a South Korean hyper cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler range (associated with Maypharm/Monalisa) built on a proprietary Hybrid (Hy-BRID) cross-linking process. The line spans Soft, Mild, Hard and Ultra densities to cover fine lines through deep volumisation and facial sculpting. It is CE-marked and supplied in single-use prefilled syringes.
howItWorks: A cross-linked HA gel that physically restores volume and binds water in the dermis/subcutis for hydration and structural support. Hybrid cross-linking is used to raise cohesivity and slow enzymatic degradation, with density stepped across variants so lift capacity increases from Soft to Ultra.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel of non-animal origin (BDDE cross-linker); a specific mg/mL concentration is not publicly confirmed. Lidocaine-containing presentations (e.g. Ultra Lidocaine) are offered for injection comfort.
usageNotes: Match variant density to injection depth (Soft/Mild superficial-to-mid dermis; Hard/Ultra deep dermis to supraperiosteal). Not for intravascular injection; aspirate and use correct planes. Keep hyaluronidase on hand to dissolve HA in the event of vascular compromise or overcorrection. Single-use sterile syringe, store per label.
benefits: Single family covers superficial to deep indications, simplifying stock
Density tiers support predictable case matching
Reversible with hyaluronidase, lowering procedural risk
Competitive Korean price point for enquiry-to-order
Prefilled sterile syringes streamline chairside use
indications: Deep volume restoration and facial sculpting (Ultra)

description: Colena is a South Korean monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler supplied in three densities (S, M, L) for wrinkle correction, volumisation and contouring. It is manufactured from sterile, pyrogen-free, non-animal HA gel and includes lidocaine for patient comfort. The range is CE-certified.
howItWorks: A monophasic cross-linked HA gel that adds volume and draws in water to restore hydration and soft-tissue support. Cross-link density rises from S to L, giving higher viscosity and lift for deeper placement while lighter grades spread for superficial correction.
composition: Monophasic cross-linked hyaluronic acid (non-animal origin) with 0.3% lidocaine; per-mL HA concentration is not stated on the manufacturer page.
usageNotes: Select S for superficial fine lines, M for moderate/deep folds and lips, L for deep volume and contouring. Avoid intravascular placement; inject in the plane appropriate to the grade. Keep hyaluronidase available for correction or vascular events. Single-use, store per manufacturer instructions.
benefits: Graded densities cover most facial indications
Monophasic gel supports smooth, even extrusion
Cost-competitive Korean sourcing for B2B ordering
indications: Deep tissue augmentation and facial contouring (L)

description: Juvederm is Allergan/AbbVie's flagship hyaluronic acid filler collection; its VYCROSS sub-range (Volite, Volbella, Volift/Vollure, Voluma) blends high- and low-molecular-weight HA for high cross-linking efficiency and duration. Each is a smooth cohesive gel formulated with 0.3% lidocaine and indicated by rheology from skin quality to deep volumisation. It is one of the most clinically studied HA filler families worldwide.
howItWorks: Cross-linked HA gel restores volume and binds water to smooth lines and lift tissue. The proprietary VYCROSS technology combines high- and low-MW HA to achieve efficient cross-linking, high cohesivity and lower gel concentration, tuning lift versus spread across the range for longevity and natural integration.
composition: Cross-linked HA (VYCROSS) with 0.3% lidocaine; HA concentration by product: Volite ~12 mg/mL, Volbella ~15 mg/mL, Volift/Vollure ~17.5 mg/mL, Voluma ~20 mg/mL.
usageNotes: Place by rheology and depth: Volite intradermal skin conditioning, Volbella superficial lips/fine lines, Volift mid-dermis folds and lip structure, Voluma deep/supraperiosteal cheek volumising. Not for intravascular injection; aspirate, use cannula where appropriate. Keep hyaluronidase available to reverse HA in vascular compromise or overcorrection.
features: Extensive clinical evidence and regulatory approvals
benefits: Long duration (typically up to ~12-24 months by product) reduces retreatment
Broad indication coverage from a single collection
indications: Lip augmentation and perioral fine lines (Volbella)
Nasolabial folds, marionette lines, lip structure (Volift/Vollure)

description: Juvederm Volux (VYC-25L) is the densest, most cohesive gel in the VYCROSS range, formulated specifically for jawline and chin definition. It carries the highest HA concentration in the collection to deliver strong lift and near bone-like sculpting for lower-face contouring. It is FDA-approved for improving jawline definition in adults.
howItWorks: A highly cross-linked HA gel that adds firm structural volume and binds water at deep planes. VYCROSS high/low-MW HA blending maximises cohesivity and elastic modulus (G'), producing a dense, sculptable gel that resists deformation for durable jaw and chin projection.
composition: Cross-linked HA (VYCROSS) at ~25 mg/mL with 0.3% lidocaine.
usageNotes: Deep subcutaneous/supraperiosteal placement along the jawline and chin; high G' gel intended for structural, not superficial, use. Avoid intravascular injection; aspirate and inject slowly. Keep hyaluronidase available to reverse HA if vascular compromise or overcorrection occurs. Single-use sterile syringe.
features: Highest HA concentration in VYCROSS (~25 mg/mL)
Very high cohesivity and elastic modulus (G')
benefits: Non-surgical lower-face contouring with strong projection
indications: Chin projection and correction of retrusion

description: Elravie (Elravie Premier) is Humedix's premium monophasic hyaluronic acid filler range from South Korea, built on its HI (High-molecular Ideal Reticulated matrix) cross-linking technology. The line includes Ultra Volume-L, Deep Line-L and Light-L grades for volumising, deep-fold and superficial correction respectively. All grades are supplied with lidocaine.
howItWorks: A monophasic cross-linked HA gel that restores volume and binds water for hydration and support. HI Technology improves cross-linking efficiency and purity to enhance cohesivity and longevity, with viscosity stepped across grades so Ultra Volume lifts deeply while Light corrects superficially.
composition: 23 mg/mL cross-linked hyaluronic acid with 0.3% lidocaine (reported to include mannitol as an antioxidant/stabiliser); HA purity stated above 99.5%.
usageNotes: Place Light-L superficially, Deep Line-L in mid-to-deep dermis, and Ultra Volume-L in deep subcutaneous/supraperiosteal planes. Avoid intravascular injection; use correct depth per grade. Keep hyaluronidase available for correction or vascular events. Single-use, store per manufacturer instructions.
features: High HA purity (>99.5%) with mannitol stabiliser
benefits: Consistent monophasic gel for smooth injection
Grade range covers superficial to deep indications
Lidocaine and mannitol support comfort and stability
Established Korean manufacturer for reliable B2B supply
indications: Nasolabial folds and moderate-deep wrinkles (Deep Line-L)

description: Belotero Volume is Merz's high-density hyaluronic acid filler for restoring deep volume and structural support to the face. It uses Merz's Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM) technology for smooth tissue integration and a natural lift without irregularities. The lidocaine presentation adds injection comfort.
howItWorks: A high-density cross-linked HA gel that replaces lost volume and binds water at deep planes. CPM technology produces variable cross-link density within one cohesive gel, allowing even tissue integration and natural-looking projection while resisting migration.
composition: 26 mg/mL cross-linked sodium hyaluronate (CPM) with 3 mg/mL (approx. 0.3%) lidocaine in the lidocaine presentation.
usageNotes: Deep subcutaneous/supraperiosteal placement for volumising cheeks, temples, chin and jawline. Not for intravascular injection; aspirate and inject in the correct deep plane. Keep hyaluronidase available to reverse HA for vascular compromise or overcorrection. Single-use sterile prefilled syringe.
benefits: Trusted Merz brand aids patient acceptance

description: Replengen is a South Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid filler range using Hexagonal Block Crosslinking Technology (HBCT) to build a compact structure that resists degradation. The line includes Implant S, Volume, Deep and Fine grades spanning superficial wrinkles to deep volumisation and contouring. Grades are offered with lidocaine and are supplied in prefilled syringes.
howItWorks: A cross-linked HA gel that adds volume and binds water for hydration and tissue support. The HBCT hexagonal-block cross-linking is designed to create a dense, stable network that slows enzymatic breakdown for extended longevity, with viscosity stepped across grades for depth-appropriate placement.
composition: 24 mg/mL cross-linked hyaluronic acid with lidocaine (0.3% in lidocaine presentations); non-animal HA.
usageNotes: Place Fine superficially, Deep in mid-to-deep dermis, Volume/Implant S in deep subcutaneous planes for contouring. Avoid intravascular injection; select depth by grade. Keep hyaluronidase available for correction or vascular compromise. Single-use, store per manufacturer instructions.
benefits: Grade range covers fine lines to deep volume

description: Belotero is Merz's core hyaluronic acid filler range (Soft, Balance, Intense) built on Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM) technology for seamless tissue integration and even, natural correction. Densities are stepped from superficial fine-line smoothing (Soft) through moderate wrinkles (Balance) to deep folds and lip volume (Intense). CPM gels are noted for smooth integration and the ability to be placed superficially.
howItWorks: Cross-linked HA gel that smooths lines and adds volume while binding water. CPM manufacturing creates zones of variable cross-link density within a single cohesive gel, letting it mimic tissue behaviour, integrate homogeneously and be layered from superficial dermis to deeper planes by grade.
composition: Cross-linked sodium hyaluronate (CPM); reported concentrations ~Balance 22.5 mg/mL and Intense 25.5 mg/mL, with Soft a lower-density grade. Lidocaine presentations available.
usageNotes: Match grade to depth: Soft superficial fine lines, Balance mid-dermis moderate wrinkles, Intense deep folds and lip volume. Not for intravascular injection; use appropriate plane per grade. Keep hyaluronidase available to reverse HA in vascular compromise or overcorrection. Single-use sterile syringe.
features: Lidocaine options and strong clinical record
benefits: Smooth, natural correction with low lumpiness
Grade range covers fine lines to deep folds
Established Merz brand supports patient trust
indications: Severe nasolabial folds and marionette lines (Intense)

description: Tesoro is a South Korean stabilised hyaluronic acid filler range for facial contouring, wrinkle correction and volumisation. It is made from high-purity, non-animal HA refined through a multi-phase purification process and is available in Fine, Deep, Sub-Q and Implant grades. Grades are offered with or without lidocaine.
howItWorks: A cross-linked/stabilised HA gel that restores volume and binds water for hydration and tissue support. Cross-linking increases cohesivity and durability, with viscosity stepped across grades so Fine corrects superficially while Sub-Q and Implant provide deep lift and contouring.
composition: 20 mg/mL stabilised hyaluronic acid with 0.3% lidocaine option (Implant grade reported at 24 mg/mL); non-animal HA with multi-phase purification.
usageNotes: Place Fine superficially, Deep in mid-to-deep dermis, Sub-Q/Implant in deep subcutaneous planes for volume and shaping. Avoid intravascular injection; use correct depth per grade. Keep hyaluronidase available for correction or vascular events. Single-use, store per label.
features: Stabilised non-animal HA (20 mg/mL; Implant 24 mg/mL)
benefits: Grade range covers fine lines to deep contouring
Cost-competitive Korean sourcing for B2B ordering
